hero_description.en: In a rapidly evolving media landscape, guesswork is a liability. The Media Technology Monitor (MTM) is an investment in unparalleled evidence-based market intelligence that will sharpen your strategy, drive audience engagement and secure your competitive edge.

problem_description.en: Attention fragmentation is real – know where your audience is now, where it will be next and who you may not be reaching yet.

insight_1_title.en: Your audience is moving across platforms and services to get what they need, when the want it.

insight_1_description.en: Canadians no longer live on just one platform. They stream on one service, scroll on another, and stay connect to the world around them on a third. MTM tracks the full media diet across every screen and with every platform and service, so you can capture real-world insights for any target audience

insight_2_description.en: The MTM allows you to see Canada in high definition. From streaming subscriptions to podcast habits to device ownership - not all Canadians have the same media behaviours. Filter data by specific racialized groups, families, age groups, income brackets and more so that you can connect when and how your audience needs you.

tools_title.en: Tools that empower you to track the shifts

media_tools_analytic_description.en: Query MTM's full dataset by platform, region, language, and demographic. Build custom cross-tabs in minutes, track adoption curves over time, and model where your audience will be in three years — all at the click of a button.

media_tools_census_description.en: Map your audience at the postal code level. Identify underserved communities, size local markets, and benchmark your reach against the national population — all from a single dashboard sourced directly from Statistics Canada census data.

workflow_title.en: How MTM fits the way you already work

workflow_description.en: You don't open a research tool and start clicking. You have a business question. MTM is built to answer it, at every stage of your workflow.

workflow_step_1_description.en: Start with a question — platform reach, time spent, device ownership, service provider. Pull exactly the variables you need from and the MTM lets you build your view in minutes.

workflow_step_2_description.en: Drag variables into rows and columns. Filter by region, language, age or strategic target group. Every output is yours to configure - no fixed tables, no waiting.

workflow_step_3_description.en: Download your analysis in presentation-ready formats. Drop it straight into a deck, a brief, or a regulatory submission - formatted and ready to go.

testimonial_title.en: What media and broadcasting companies are saying about us

testimonial_quote.en: When it comes to technology ownership and usage in Canada, the MTM is THE go-to source of information. For our team, this resource is invaluable because it allows us to make informed decisions with confidence and stay one step ahead in an ever-changing media landscape. It is a fundamental tool for our strategic planning and innovation efforts.
